title: Chef Josh Boutwood inspired to aim higher as Helm retains 2 Michelin stars
summary: Chef Josh Boutwood's Helm has successfully retained its two Michelin stars, a feat that no other restaurant in the Philippines has achieved since the arrival of the Michelin Guide last year.
